text:
Eli M.: Heads-up: overnight batch showed ~3.7% of leads routed to owners during local off-hours. SDRs are getting woken up.
Clara: Yep — looks like a timezone fallback bug in the RR router. When HubSpot owner_tz is empty we fall back to UTC and it skews the rotation.
Samir (SDR): Got a 1am assignment this morning and it sat unclaimed for 2 hours. Can we avoid assigning outside someone's local shift unless they opted in?
Ops-Lee: Quick root: a Salesforce bulk sync stripped company.timezone for some records. Our HR-derived default only runs during onboarding so older contacts had no tz. RR then used UTC.
Eli M.: Proposed short-term fix: HubSpot workflow to set `owner_tz` from company.country -> tz map if blank, otherwise set `owner_tz=company.timezone`. Also add a soft guard in the router: if claim_time not within owner_work_hours, skip and mark lead property `deferred_for_tz_protection=true`.
Clara: Also add a fallback path: if a lead is deferred for >25m, escalate to `inbound-day-default` owner group rather than keep retrying. That prevents indefinite starvation.
Samir (SDR): Love the deferred flag. Could we surface a small note on the lead activity timeline: "Deferred assignment due to timezone protection"? That would cut confusion for SDRs.
Ops-Lee: Will do. Implementation plan: 1) HS workflow rule to backfill owner_tz using country map for missing values; 2) Router change: prefer owners with `active_window=true`, set `deferred_for_tz_protection=true` on skip; 3) TTL=25m -> move to fallback pool. Canary 1% traffic for 2h.
Eli M.: Metrics to add: `assign_out_of_hours_pct`, `deferred_for_tz_protection_count`, and `fallback_after_ttl_count`. Add to marketing dashboard and create alert if fallback_after_ttl_count > 50 in 1h.
Clara: Edge-case: some accounts legitimately want night coverage. Add owner-level opt-in `accept_assign_outside_window=true`. Router should honor that.
Samir (SDR): Also request: when a lead is moved to fallback pool, include a note in the HubSpot owner card explaining fallback reason and timestamp.
workflow-bot: Workflow created: "owner_tz_backfill_v1" scheduled to run once. Rule id: WF-8891.
Ops-Lee: I'll push HS workflow change at 11:30 PT to canary. Routing guard will be behind feature flag so we can flip quickly.
Eli M.: Please add a simple log line for ops debugging, e.g.:
[2026-04-02T11:32:01Z] lead=LD-8877 action=deferred_for_tz_protection owner_tz=null company_country=CA
[2026-04-02T11:57:45Z] lead=LD-8877 action=fallback_after_ttl fallback_group=inbound-day-default
Clara: I'll open the PR for router guard and opt-in flag. Will add unit tests for tz derivation.
Samir (SDR): Thanks team. Hopefully no more 1am pings. :coffee: 
Eli M.: After canary, we'll run a 24h audit to ensure deferred_count decreases and no regressions. Reconvene tomorrow 9:30 PT if canary looks flaky.
workflow-bot: Alert rule created: if assign_out_of_hours_pct > 1% for 30m -> #marketing (rule id RB-7033).
